description: This file defines a PHP class BedrockDataAutomationClient in the Aws\BedrockDataAutomation namespace. The class extends AwsClient and includes method annotations for interacting with the Data Automation for Amazon Bedrock service, including methods for creating, deleting, retrieving, listing, and updating blueprints and data automation projects, both synchronously and asynchronously.

classes.name: BedrockDataAutomationClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon Bedrock Data Automation service, providing methods for managing blueprints and data automation projects.

methods.description: Creates a new blueprint in the Data Automation service.

methods.name: createBlueprintAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new blueprint.

methods.name: createBlueprintVersion
methods.description: Creates a new version of an existing blueprint.

methods.name: createBlueprintVersionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new version of an existing blueprint.

methods.name: createDataAutomationProject
methods.description: Creates a new data automation project.

methods.name: createDataAutomationProjectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new data automation project.
